wikidot5e:spell:bless.effectSummary: Choose up to three creatures within range. Until the spell ends, each target can add 1d4 whenever it makes an attack roll or saving throw. Each slot level above 1st lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:blight.effectSummary: One creature you can see in range makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Undead and constructs are unaffected. A plant creature or magical plant saves with disadvantage and takes maximum damage instead of rolled damage. A nonmagical plant that is not a creature gets no save and immediately withers and dies. Each slot level above 4th adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:blinding-smite.effectSummary: The next melee weapon attack you hit with during the spell deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage. The target also makes a Constitution save; on a failure it is blinded until the spell ends. A blinded target repeats the Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending the blindness on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:blindness-deafness.effectSummary: One creature you can see in range makes a Constitution save. On a failure, choose for it to be blinded or deafened for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. Each slot level above 2nd lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:blink.effectSummary: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20; on 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane. The spell fails and the casting is wasted if you were already there. At the start of your next turn, or when the spell ends while you are Ethereal, return to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of where you vanished; if none exists, use the nearest unoccupied space, randomly choosing among equally near spaces. You can dismiss the spell as an action. While Ethereal, you can see and hear your origin plane in gray tones only out to 60 feet and can affect or be affected only by creatures on the Ethereal Plane; creatures elsewhere cannot perceive or interact with you unless they have an ability that specifically permits it.

wikidot5e:spell:blur.effectSummary: For the duration, creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker ignores this effect if it does not rely on sight, such as through blindsight, or can see through illusions, such as with truesight.

wikidot5e:spell:bones-of-the-earth.effectSummary: Create up to six stone pillars from visible ground in range. Each is a 5-foot-diameter cylinder up to 30 feet high, requires ground wide enough for it, has AC 5 and 30 HP, and can arise beneath a Medium or smaller creature. At 0 HP a pillar becomes rubble that creates difficult terrain in a 10-foot radius until cleared. A creature above a new pillar can make a Dexterity save or be lifted and may choose to fail. If an obstacle prevents a pillar from reaching full height, a creature on it takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained between pillar and obstacle. A restrained creature can use an action for a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC; on success it is freed and must move off or fall from the pillar. Each slot level above 6th creates two additional pillars.

wikidot5e:spell:booming-blade.effectSummary: Make a melee attack with the weapon used to cast the spell against one creature within 5 feet. On a hit, apply the weapon attack normally and sheath the target in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If it willingly moves at least 5 feet before then, it takes 1d8 thunder damage and the spell ends. At character level 5, the initial hit also deals 1d8 thunder and the movement damage becomes 2d8; at level 11 these become 2d8 and 3d8, and at level 17 they become 3d8 and 4d8.

wikidot5e:spell:branding-smite.effectSummary: The next weapon attack you hit with before the spell ends deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage. If the target was invisible it becomes visible, sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius, and cannot become invisible again until the spell ends. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 to the extra damage.

wikidot5e:spell:burning-hands.effectSummary: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The fire also ignites flammable objects in the area that are not being worn or carried. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 damage.
